name: Passenger Compartment

source.reason: Explicit CUR-003 source reference; edition/permission not certified.

originalText:
Passenger Compartment: The clockwork’s interior
contains space enough to hold one creature of a size
smaller than it. While inside this space, the creature
cannot see or hear anything that happens outside
it, cannot be targeted by attacks or other effects, and
has enough air to breathe for 8 hours. A creature
must use an action to enter or exit this space. If the
clockwork with the compartment becomes injured,
the creature it carries in its space, must succeed on a
Strength challenge roll or take half the damage that
injured the clockwork. If the clockwork becomes
incapacitated or destroyed, the creature it carries
takes the damage that incapacitated or destroyed the
clockwork and falls prone in the empty space nearest
to the clockwork.
